description: The University of Reading publishes MAPSECC: London, a database linking urban physical characteristics with population and activity. Version 2.0 combines land-cover fractions, building types and materials, human activity profiles, transport infrastructure, road lengths and spatial attractors. A 500 m grid provides a shared spatial reference. The archive lists separate ZIP packages for each component, auxiliary inputs, processing code and documentation. Activity profiles draw on the 2014–2015 UK time-use survey; the other components have their own source periods, not one observation date. Zenodo states CC-BY-4.0 and an embargo ending 1 April 2027, with access requests available. Reuse is free under that licence, but file access is currently restricted and was not requested or tested. The linked v2.0 article adds building roughness and morphology parameters. Modellers could use the harmonised components in simulations connecting building heat exchanges, travel and population activity in London. They still need to check each component’s resolution and assumptions. This is a city-specific processed database, not a replacement for global building or population inventories.
